. 1 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

The petitioner is in custody since 30.10.2024 in connection with GR Case No.612-A of 2023 arising out of Patnagarh P.S. Case No.151 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
P a t n a g a r h o f t h e a l l e g e d c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 342/376(2)(n)/365/366/370/420/506/34 of IPC.
3.
It is alleged that one Kalia Majhi forcibly took the victim to Rajasthan and had her married to one Ramswarup.
The victim stayed with Ramswarup for four years.
Though the petitioner has been charge-sheeted, yet the victim, in her statement recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. has not whispered a word against him.
4. Taking into consideration the above fact and in particular the statement of the victim, I am inclined to take a lenient view.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court in seisin over the matter may deem fit and proper to impose including the condition that he shall personally appear before the Trial Court on each date of posting of the case without fail.
5. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
